title: Distributive Fairness in Large Language Models: Evaluating Alignment with Human Values

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model-generated multi-agent resource allocations against fundamental distributive fairness axioms (equitability, envy-freeness, Rawlsian maximin) and comparing the LLMs' preference for economic efficiency versus fairness to human baselines.

Assigning the LLM the role of a stakeholder ('skin in the game') within a resource allocation scenario and measuring whether the model unfairly allocates higher payoffs to its own assigned persona compared to when it acts as an impartial decision-maker.
